root_cause: Actual VB5/6 graphical CommandButton has runtime-owned ThunderRT5/6CommandButton, native Button superclass and BS_OWNERDRAW. Existing ordinary painter deliberately rejects that mode. Four controls per real sample still call DrawFrameControl(DFC_BUTTON,DFCS_BUTTONPUSH) on their exact child DC; DLL loading is not the failure.

Native API runs first and its return/error/adjusted RECT are preserved. Source font/geometry/input and runtime image/body remain native; only runtime ANSI captions borrow the existing System font. No new detours, ABI, product components or original resource bytes.
